scope: Visually inspected every illustrated page of both official booklets; no physical assembly test.

manual_choice.decision: BOTH booklets required;32-page case booklet explicitly redirects to drawer booklet atp31. They are NOT alternatives.

tools: Drill with bit appropriate to supplied-kit wall branch
safety: No TV or other heavy objects on top.
Children must not climb or hang on drawers.
Read all instructions; seek professional advice if wall type uncertain.

case_names.153548 / 158568: push-in foot pad, alternative printed codes

prefitted_cabinet_runners.note: Already on side panels in step1. Do not invent installation or extra runner screws.

drawer_names.115339: short round-head fitting;neutral name avoids unverified mechanism claim

case_steps.title: Side-panel cam bolts
case_steps.description: Fit five cam bolts into each side inner face. The three cabinet runners per side are already fitted.
case_steps.orientation: Both sides flat, inner faces up.

case_steps.title: Side foot pads
case_steps.description: Push two foot pads into the bottom edge of each side.

case_steps.title: Plinth brackets
case_steps.description: Attach the two angle brackets to the plinth with two screws per bracket.
case_steps.tip: 2x refers to two two-screw bracket operations.

case_steps.title: Plinth feet
case_steps.description: Fit the remaining two foot pads into the plinth lower edge.

case_steps.title: Plinth to first side
case_steps.description: Stand the plinth on the first side at the bottom front and attach with two screws.
case_steps.orientation: First side flat inner face up; plinth perpendicular.
case_steps.tip: Bracket/plinth faces inward as shown in correct inset, not outside.

case_steps.title: Three front rails
case_steps.description: Put six dowels into the three narrow front rails, one at each end. Seat all three onto first side.
case_steps.orientation: First side down. Three rails stand perpendicular across case width.

case_steps.title: First rail cams
case_steps.description: Insert and turn three cams at the first-side rail joints.

case_steps.title: Bottom panel
case_steps.description: Fit four dowels, two at each end, and seat bottom panel onto first side.
case_steps.orientation: First side down; bottom spans width.
case_steps.tip: Asymmetric orientation: single cam hole at each end is toward rear half. Do not reverse panel as in crossed-out inset.

case_steps.title: First bottom cam
case_steps.description: Insert and turn one cam in the bottom at first-side joint.

case_steps.title: Lower rear support rail
case_steps.description: Fit four dowels, two at each end, then seat broad lower rear support rail onto first side.
case_steps.orientation: First side down; rear support rail perpendicular to bottom.
case_steps.tip: This is a rigid structural rail, separate from thin full back fitted later.

case_steps.title: First rear-rail cam
case_steps.description: Insert and turn one cam at first-side rear-rail joint.

case_steps.title: Second side
case_steps.description: Lower second side over all exposed dowels and bolts.
case_steps.orientation: First side down; second side parallel above.
case_steps.tip: Inner face and pre-fitted runners face inward. Match finished edges.

case_steps.title: Second plinth bracket
case_steps.description: Attach plinth bracket to second side with two screws.
case_steps.tip: 1x refers to one two-screw bracket operation.

case_steps.title: Remaining five side cams
case_steps.description: Fit five cams: three front rails, bottom, rear support rail.

case_steps.title: Top cam bolts
case_steps.description: Fit four cam bolts in top underside.

case_steps.title: Wall brackets on top
case_steps.description: Fit two wall brackets under top rear with one short furniture screw and washer each.
case_steps.tip: Slotted brackets extend rearward; long wall leg will point down after top is upright.

case_steps.title: Fit the top
case_steps.description: With helper bring frame upright. Insert four dowels in upper side edges and lower top.
case_steps.tip: Match front/rear top orientation to correct inset, not crossed-out reversed top.

case_steps.title: Lock top
case_steps.description: Insert and turn four cams, two in each upper side edge.

case_steps.title: Position back and first nail
case_steps.description: With helper place case front down, rear up. Unfold two-section fibreboard back, align within rear outline and bracket cutouts; add first upper-corner nail.

case_steps.title: Second upper-corner nail
case_steps.description: Align opposite upper corner beside other wall bracket and add one nail.

case_steps.title: Third-corner nail
case_steps.description: Hold third corner aligned and add one nail.

case_steps.title: Remaining back nails
case_steps.description: Add remaining27 nails around perimeter.
case_steps.tip: Total30 nails. Do not invent nail spacing dimensions.

case_steps.title: Mark wall and open back slots
case_steps.description: Raise with helper and position against wall. Slide both brackets to wall and tighten furniture screws. Mark wall through slots, then pierce matching thin-back openings with pointed tool.
case_steps.orientation: Upright at wall; drawer openings empty.
case_steps.tip: Drawing shows BOTH pencil marking and opening fibreboard through bracket slots.

case_steps.title: Move clear of wall
case_steps.description: Move empty case away from wall marks for drilling.

case_steps.title: Choose actual wall branch
case_steps.description: A solid: supplied plugs. B hollow: illustrated one fixing over stud and one in hollow wall. C solid wood: no plugs. Seek professional advice if uncertain.
case_steps.orientation: Show original source wall diagrams, no universal 3D drill animation.
case_steps.tip: A8mm/70mm deep; B8mm/about30mm at hollow point; C3mm/about30mm, as supplied-kit source examples, never universal fixing prescriptions.

case_steps.title: Drill chosen wall branch
case_steps.description: A p27: two holes. B p28: ONE hollow-point hole, with other fixing located at stud per drawing. C p30: two pilot holes.
case_steps.tip: Branch pagesA27,B28,C30; do not invent stud drilling dimensions.

case_steps.title: Insert plugs if applicable
case_steps.description: A p27: two plugs. B p29: one plug. C: skip plugs entirely.
case_steps.tip: Do not depict two generic hollow-wall anchors; one fixing is at a stud.

case_steps.title: Secure both wall restraints
case_steps.description: Return empty chest to position and secure two brackets with two long screws and two remaining washers.
case_steps.tip: p31 sends reader to separate drawer booklet. Complete drawer1-9 before case29.

case_steps.title: Top warning drawer
case_steps.description: Place the warning-labeled drawer at top. Engage tilted drawer then lower it level into runners.
case_steps.orientation: Upright anchored; warning inside top drawer visible.
case_steps.tip: Overlaps drawer9/p8. Retain both source references without creating an extra drawer.

drawer_steps.title: Drawer front bolts
drawer_steps.description: Fit four bolts into inner face of drawer front.
drawer_steps.orientation: Front outer face down on protected surface.
drawer_steps.tip: Counts are for one drawer; repeat for all three.

drawer_steps.title: Fit drawer sides
drawer_steps.description: Insert four dowels, two per side, and seat sides onto front.
drawer_steps.orientation: Front face down; sides perpendicular, bottom grooves aligned, cam holes outward.
drawer_steps.tip: One side carries warning label. Use that drawer at top.

drawer_steps.title: Lock front joints
drawer_steps.description: Fit and turn four cams, two per side.

drawer_steps.title: Slide drawer bottom
drawer_steps.description: Slide thin base through side grooves and fully into front groove.
drawer_steps.orientation: Front face down; base enters from open rear.

drawer_steps.title: Fit drawer back
drawer_steps.description: Fit back across side rear ends and around bottom edge.
drawer_steps.orientation: Front face down; back at far end.
drawer_steps.tip: Match lower-edge notch shown in inset for centre brace.

drawer_steps.title: Secure back and side fittings
drawer_steps.description: Tap four110519 fasteners into side/back joints, two each. Screw two115339 short round-head fittings near front ends of outer sides.
drawer_steps.orientation: Front face down; access outer sides.

drawer_steps.title: Fit drawer runners
drawer_steps.description: Turn drawer bottom up. Fit pair of runners with three screws each.
drawer_steps.orientation: Drawer upside down; rollers at rear.
drawer_steps.tip: Runner handedness and lower-edge alignment as source.

drawer_steps.title: Support drawer bottom
drawer_steps.description: Start screw at front underside location. Hook central brace over screw, turn/tighten, then seat brace at back notch and secure rear end with second screw.
drawer_steps.orientation: Drawer upside down; brace spans FRONT TO BACK below centre of bottom.
drawer_steps.tip: Follow all five small numbered details. Brace is not a widthwise bar.

drawer_steps.title: Insert three drawers
drawer_steps.description: After all three are assembled, engage each at slight angle and lower level into cabinet runners.
drawer_steps.tip: Warning-labeled drawer goes at top. This and main29 refer to same final insertion.

case_thin: 1rear fibreboard back folded into2 width sections, upper bracket cutouts
boards.warning: One labeled side in top drawer.

notes: A has2supplied plugs; B shows one fixing aligned with stud and one supplied hollow-wall plug; C has no plugs.
Originalp25 dimensions are supplied-kit examples, not universal choices.
Keep actual drilling diagrams accessible; 3D wall only conveys bracket relationship.

geometry_guidance.floor: Case5-14 on first side;17-18upright;19-22front down rear up;23+upright.
geometry_guidance.front_rails: Three slender bars across front, not full-depth shelves.
geometry_guidance.rear_support: Vertical broad rigid rail across lower rear, separate from thin full back.
geometry_guidance.back: Two folded width sections;30nails around perimeter introduced1+1+1+27.
geometry_guidance.drawers: Single example can show repeated steps with explicitx3. Bottom brace runs front-to-back centred below base. Final insertion all3, warning drawer top.
geometry_guidance.limits: Panel thickness, hole locations, screw lengths, runner shapes and spacing are illustrative. Do not make manufacturing/drilling template.

ambiguities: Printed alternative part codes are not additive quantities.
Cabinet runners already fitted in drawings.
B wall branch only explicitly drills/plugs the hollow point; do not invent stud pilot dimensions.
Case29 and drawer9 overlap;retain both source refs.
Names for hardware are descriptive, not claimed official catalog names.
